opening.argument: The page presents a movie-ticket promotion offering $100 in Fandango Bucks, with an email field and a Continue button. It directs viewers to trial30.com/tickets, and the speaker identifies the offer as a promotion found there. The speaker also says submitting an email leads to account creation. Participation is required, so this is not presented as an unconditional payout from Fandango. The visible flow shows an email request and promotional terms, but it does not show a deceptive fee or establish that the promised benefit will not be delivered.

citations.quote: I wanted to share this with you because I found this promotion on trial30.com, forward slash tickets
you only have to submit your email and then it'll let you create your account
